author: athralk
method: Numba exact shortest-path-tree router: PathFinder negotiation + exact refinement + annealed LNS with negotiated stall kicks; a GATv2 destroy GNN picks which nets LNS rips up; warm-started 3 h runs, best legal run per case. runtime.json = total wall-clock of every run that contributed to a case (warm-start chain plus sibling runs), each case single-threaded.
hardware: AMD Ryzen 9 8945HS (16 threads), 15 GB RAM; RTX 4060 Laptop GPU used only for GNN training/inference
